label: pjm 76 outage fix
definition: PJM 76 Chesterfield outage fix: pjm-75 recipe verbatim on regenerated campd-unit-outages-PJM.csv (d815a3c). Chesterfield 3797 coal units 5/6 now carry COAL outage windows (skipped by gas overlay) instead of blocking the 386 MW surviving gas-CC. Corrects ~2.35 TWh of the pjm-75 2023 CC under-run. Also fixes Brunner Island, Chalk Point, Gilbert, Linden, Doswell outage routing. Per-gen reserve co-opt NOT included (memory-infeasible on 15 GB box; see pjm-reserve-ordc.md). All else pjm-75 verbatim (CT drag, CC cap, M15 offers, coal_bit 0.65, zone-agg reserve co-opt, commitment=False).
